title: Style missing from the theme
description: Layout-quality rule — an object names a style that its layout's theme does not contain: no rule of the theme carries the style, in any state. Typically a custom style deleted from the theme, or a style that did not come along when the layout moved to another theme. The Inspector still shows the style name, but the theme holds no rule for it.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A style name without a rule is a dead reference: whatever the style once set is no longer defined in the theme, and the object no longer follows any change to a style of that name.
rule.remediation: Apply an existing style of the theme to the object, or recreate the missing style in the theme.
